errors.evidence: This statement oversimplifies the arrangement of the pie slices. While it's technically true that the segments following the largest one (52.4%) are smaller, this observation is trivial and does not accurately describe the actual layout, which is not sorted in any particular order (the subsequent slices are ~4.8%, 9.5%, and 33.3%).
